doc.brief: The QTreeWidgetItem class provides an item for use with the [QTreeWidget](xref:qt:QTreeWidget) convenience class.
doc.index_brief: Item for use with the QTreeWidget convenience class

QBrush background(int column) const.brief: Returns the brush used to render the background of the specified *column*.

QBrush foreground(int column) const.brief: Returns the brush used to render the foreground (e.g. text) of the specified *column*.

QDataStream & operator<<(QDataStream &ou.brief: Writes the tree widget item *item* to stream *out*.

QDataStream & operator>>(QDataStream &in.brief: Reads a tree widget item from stream *in* into *item*.

QFont font(int column) const.brief: Returns the font used to render the text in the specified *column*.

QIcon icon(int column) const.brief: Returns the icon that is displayed in the specified *column*.

QList<QTreeWidgetItem *> takeChildren().brief: Removes the list of children and returns it, otherwise returns an empty list.

QSize sizeHint(int column) const.brief: Returns the size hint set for the tree item in the given *column* (see [QSize](xref:qt:QSize)).

QString statusTip(int column) const.brief: Returns the status tip for the contents of the given *column*.

QString text(int column) const.brief: Returns the text in the specified *column*.

QString toolTip(int column) const.brief: Returns the tool tip for the given *column*.

QString whatsThis(int column) const.brief: Returns the "What's This?" help for the contents of the given *column*.

QTreeWidget * treeWidget() const.brief: Returns the tree widget that contains the item.

QTreeWidgetItem * child(int index) const.brief: Returns the item at the given *index* in the list of the item's children.

QTreeWidgetItem * clone() const.brief: Creates a deep copy of the item and of its children.

QTreeWidgetItem * takeChild(int index).brief: Removes the item at *index* and returns it, otherwise return 0.

QTreeWidgetItem(QTreeWidget *parent, QTr.brief: Constructs a tree widget item of the specified *type* and inserts it into the given *parent* after the *preceding* item.

QTreeWidgetItem(QTreeWidget *parent, con.brief: Constructs a tree widget item of the specified *type* and appends it to the items in the given *parent*.

QTreeWidgetItem(QTreeWidget *parent, int.brief: Constructs a tree widget item of the specified *type* and appends it to the items in the given *parent*.

QTreeWidgetItem(QTreeWidgetItem *parent,.brief: Constructs a tree widget item of the specified *type* that is inserted into the *parent* after the *preceding* child item.

Constructs a tree widget item and append it to the given *parent*.

QTreeWidgetItem(const QStringList &strin.brief: Constructs a tree widget item of the specified *type*.

QTreeWidgetItem(int type).brief: Constructs a tree widget item of the specified *type*.

QVariant data(int column, int role) cons.brief: Returns the value for the item's *column* and *role*.

Qt::CheckState checkState(int column) co.brief: Returns the check state of the label in the given *column*.

Qt::ItemFlags flags() const.brief: Returns the flags used to describe the item.

bool isDisabled() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is disabled; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isExpanded() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is expanded, otherwise returns `false`.

bool isFirstColumnSpanned() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is spanning all the columns in a row; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isHidden() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is hidden, otherwise returns `false`.

bool isSelected() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is selected, otherwise returns `false`.

bool operator<(const QTreeWidgetItem &ot.brief: Returns `true` if the text in the item is less than the text in the *other* item, otherwise returns `false`.

int childCount() const.brief: Returns the number of child items.

int columnCount() const.brief: Returns the number of columns in the item.

int indexOfChild(QTreeWidgetItem *child).brief: Returns the index of the given *child* in the item's list of children.

int textAlignment(int column) const.brief: Returns the text alignment for the label in the given *column*.

int type() const.brief: Returns the type passed to the [QTreeWidgetItem](xref:qt:QTreeWidgetItem) constructor.

void addChild(QTreeWidgetItem *child).brief: Appends the *child* item to the list of children.

void addChildren(const QList<QTreeWidget.brief: Appends the given list of *children* to the item.

void emitDataChanged().brief: Causes the model associated with this item to emit a [dataChanged](xref:qt:QAbstractItemModel)() signal for this item.

void insertChild(int index, QTreeWidgetI.brief: Inserts the *child* item at *index* in the list of children.

void insertChildren(int index, const QLi.brief: Inserts the given list of *children* into the list of the item children at *index* .

void removeChild(QTreeWidgetItem *child).brief: Removes the given item indicated by *child*.

void setBackground(int column, const QBr.brief: Sets the background brush of the label in the given *column* to the specified *brush*.

void setCheckState(int column, Qt::Check.brief: Sets the item in the given *column* check state to be *state*.

void setData(int column, int role, const.brief: Sets the value for the item's *column* and *role* to the given *value*.

void setDisabled(bool disabled).brief: Disables the item if *disabled* is true; otherwise enables the item.

void setExpanded(bool expand).brief: Expands the item if *expand* is true, otherwise collapses the item.

void setFirstColumnSpanned(bool span).brief: Sets the first section to span all columns if *span* is true; otherwise all item sections are shown.

void setFlags(Qt::ItemFlags flags).brief: Sets the flags for the item to the given *flags*.

void setFont(int column, const QFont &fo.brief: Sets the font used to display the text in the given *column* to the given *font*.

void setForeground(int column, const QBr.brief: Sets the foreground brush of the label in the given *column* to the specified *brush*.

void setHidden(bool hide).brief: Hides the item if *hide* is true, otherwise shows the item.

void setIcon(int column, const QIcon &ic.brief: Sets the icon to be displayed in the given *column* to *icon*.

void setSelected(bool select).brief: Sets the selected state of the item to *select*.

void setSizeHint(int column, const QSize.brief: Sets the size hint for the tree item in the given *column* to be *size*.

void setStatusTip(int column, const QStr.brief: Sets the status tip for the given *column* to the given *statusTip*.

void setText(int column, const QString &.brief: Sets the text to be displayed in the given *column* to the given *text*.

void setTextAlignment(int column, Qt::Al.brief: Sets the text alignment for the label in the given *column* to the *alignment* specified.

void setToolTip(int column, const QStrin.brief: Sets the tooltip for the given *column* to *toolTip*.

void setWhatsThis(int column, const QStr.brief: Sets the "What's This?" help for the given *column* to *whatsThis*.

void sortChildren(int column, Qt::SortOr.brief: Sorts the children of the item using the given *order*, by the values in the given *column*.
